tasks.help.title: Pending
tasks.help.intro: Pending is the place to organize what still needs doing and turn it into concrete work. Its source of truth is Pad LOCAL, in the pendientes and planes collections; it doesn't use files as its backend or send anything outside this private board.
tasks.help.first.title: First steps
tasks.help.first.step1: Tap “Open board” on the Knowledge base card.
tasks.help.first.step2: Go to “📋 Tasks” and tap “New” to add what needs doing.
tasks.help.first.step3: Choose a type, priority, status, committed date (ETA) and, when appropriate, a plan.
tasks.help.first.step4: Open the task card to advance its status, edit it, link it or leave comments.
tasks.help.first.step5: Return to “📊 Panel” to see what's in progress, what needs attention and what to continue with.
tasks.help.tabs.title: The five tabs
tasks.help.tabs.panel.v: Summarizes classification, work in progress, alerts, next steps, active plans and recent activity. It's calculated from board data and doesn't use tokens.
tasks.help.tabs.tasks.v: Lists individual PEND items, lets you filter them and open their details to work with them.
tasks.help.tabs.plans.v: Groups tasks under PLAN records and calculates progress based on how many child tasks are done.
tasks.help.tabs.learning.v: Shows the study topics and paths whiteboard; its data lives in its own Pad LOCAL collections.
tasks.help.tabs.reports.v: Stores transcript analyses; from each report you can review findings and create the proposed tasks.

tasks.help.buttons.title: Buttons and actions
tasks.help.buttons.sidebarNew.v: Creates a task without opening the board first.
tasks.help.buttons.openBoard.v: Opens the Knowledge base and its tabs.
tasks.help.buttons.filters.v: Filters the task grid without changing any data.
tasks.help.buttons.card.v: Opens properties, description, relations, timeline and comments.
tasks.help.buttons.newTask.v: Creates a PEND with a type, priority, status and optional plan.
tasks.help.buttons.advance.v: Moves a task through its status cycle.
tasks.help.buttons.edit.v: Changes a task or plan's data.
tasks.help.buttons.relations.v: Links what this item blocks or removes that link; “Blocked by” is calculated automatically.
tasks.help.buttons.comment.v: Adds an entry to the timeline; Ctrl+Enter also sends it.
tasks.help.buttons.newPlan.v: Creates a PLAN; then assign tasks from each PEND item's “Plan” field.
tasks.help.buttons.openPlan.v: Shows the plan's details, child tasks and progress.
tasks.help.buttons.audio.v: Available to administrators: opens transcript analysis. It uses tokens when you tap “Analyze”.
tasks.help.buttons.analysis.v: Available to administrators: finds duplicates and missing data with AI. It uses tokens; each proposal is approved or dismissed separately.
tasks.help.buttons.reorganize.v: Available to administrators: analyzes tasks, plans and reports together. It uses tokens and doesn't apply proposals without approval.
tasks.help.buttons.delete.v: Deletes the task or plan after asking for confirmation.
tasks.help.warning.title: Watch out
tasks.help.warning.text: Tasks and plans live in Pad LOCAL, not in files. Deleting a task can't be undone; deleting a plan leaves its tasks without a plan. AI analyses use tokens, but their proposals are never applied automatically.
